			const ROOT_DOMAIN = ".robomq.io";
			const isFrPage = location.pathname.startsWith('/fr');

			// 🔐 COOKIE HELPERS (host + root domain)
			function setGoogTrans(val) {
				document.cookie = "googtrans=" + val + "; path=/; max-age=86400";
				document.cookie = "googtrans=" + val + "; path=/; domain=" + ROOT_DOMAIN + "; max-age=86400";
			}

			function clearGoogTrans() {
				document.cookie = "googtrans=; path=/; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC";
				document.cookie = "googtrans=; path=/; domain=" + ROOT_DOMAIN + "; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 UTC";
			}

			function hideDropdown() {
				const style = document.createElement('style');
				style.textContent =
					'.gtranslate_wrapper, select.gt_selector.notranslate { display:none!important }';
				document.head.appendChild(style);
			}

			// 🌍 Runtime Cloudflare Geo (NOT cached, NOT delayed)
			let country = null;
			try {

				const response = await fetch('/cdn-cgi/trace');
				const text = await response.text();

				const match = text.match(/loc=(\w+)/);

				country = match ? match[1] : null;

				console.log("Country of the user", country);
			} catch (e) {
				console.error(e);
			}

			if (!country) return;
			if (
				country === 'FR' &&
				location.pathname === '/' &&
				location.hostname === 'www.robomq.io'
			) {
				location.replace('/fr');
				return;
			}

			// 🔒 /fr pages → NEVER translate
			if (isFrPage) {
				clearGoogTrans();
				hideDropdown();
				return;
			}
			if (country !== 'FR') {
				hideDropdown();
			}

			const target = (country === 'FR') ? "/en/fr" : "/en/en";

			// Apply cookie BEFORE GTranslate loads

			if (!document.cookie.includes("googtrans=" + target)) {
				setGoogTrans(target);

				const key = "gt_applied_" + location.pathname;
				if (!sessionStorage.getItem(key)) {
					sessionStorage.setItem(key, "1");
					location.reload();
					return;
				}
			}

			// Force GTranslate if already loaded

			function forceTranslate() {
				if (typeof doGTranslate === 'function') {
					doGTranslate(country === 'FR' ? "en|fr" : "en|en");
					return true;
				}

				return false;
			}

			if (!forceTranslate()) {
				const i = setInterval(() => {
					if (forceTranslate()) clearInterval(i);
				}, 50);

				setTimeout(() => clearInterval(i), 3000);
			}

		})();
	</script>

    function calculateHeaderOffset() {
      const hiddenSection = document.querySelector('[data-id="86e3c21"]');
      const scrollPosition = window.scrollY;
      const isSectionHidden = isSectionActuallyHidden(hiddenSection);
      const stickyMenubar = document.querySelector('[data-id="4095b79"]');

      let baseOffset = 0;

      const isSafari = /^((?!chrome|android).)*safari/i.test(
        navigator.userAgent,
      );

      if (scrollPosition >= 30 || isSectionHidden) {
        if (stickyMenubar && isSafari) {
          if (stickyMenubar.offsetHeight > 0) {
            baseOffset = stickyMenubar.offsetHeight;
          } else {
            const computedHeight = parseInt(
              window.getComputedStyle(stickyMenubar).height,
              10,
            );
            if (computedHeight > 0) {
              baseOffset = computedHeight;
            } else {
              baseOffset = 80;
            }
          }
        } else if (stickyMenubar && !isSafari) {
          const menubarRect = stickyMenubar.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (menubarRect.top <= 5 && menubarRect.height > 0) {
            baseOffset = menubarRect.height;
          }
        }

        if (baseOffset === 0) {
          baseOffset = getVisibleHeaderHeight();

          if (baseOffset === 0 && isSafari) {
            const potentialHeaders = [
              '[data-elementor-type="header"]',
              "header",
              ".header",
              "#header",
              '[class*="header"]',
              '[id*="header"]',
              '[class*="menu"]',
              '[id*="menu"]',
              '[class*="nav"]',
              '[id*="nav"]',
            ];

            for (const selector of potentialHeaders) {
              const elements = document.querySelectorAll(selector);

              for (const element of elements) {
                const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
                const style = window.getComputedStyle(element);

                if (
                  rect.top >= -30 &&
                  rect.top <= 30 &&
                  (rect.height > 0 || element.offsetHeight > 0) &&
                  style.display !== "none"
                ) {
                  baseOffset = Math.max(rect.height, element.offsetHeight);
                  break;
                }
              }

              if (baseOffset > 0) break;
            }
          }
        }
      } else {
        baseOffset = getVisibleHeaderHeight();
      }

      const buttonRect = askAiButton.getBoundingClientRect();
      const buttonBottom = buttonRect.bottom;

      let dynamicGap;
      if (isSafari) {
        dynamicGap = baseOffset;
      } else {
        if (buttonBottom > 45) {
          dynamicGap = baseOffset + 12;
        } else {
          dynamicGap = baseOffset + 6;
        }
      }

      return Math.max(dynamicGap, 0);
    }

    function updatePanelPosition() {
      if (isExpanded) return; // expanded panel is centered via CSS, no offset needed
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const headerOffset = calculateHeaderOffset();

        sidePanel.classList.add("positioned");
        sidePanel.style.setProperty("--panel-top-offset", `${headerOffset}px`);
      });
    }

    function applyMarginShift(el) {
      if (!el || !isDesktopView() || isExpanded) return;

      let panelWidth = "30vw";
      if (window.innerWidth >= 1920) {
        panelWidth = "28vw";
      } else if (window.innerWidth <= 1439) {
        panelWidth = "35vw";
      }

      el.style.transition = "margin-right 0.4s ease";
      el.style.marginRight = panelWidth;
    }

    function removeMarginShift(el) {
      if (!el) return;
      el.style.marginRight = "";
    }

    function openPanel() {
      if (!isDesktopView()) return;

      const mainContent = getMainContentElement();

      updatePanelPosition();

      setTimeout(() => {
        sidePanel.classList.add("open");

        if (!iframeLoaded) {
          docIframe.src = "https://copilot.robomq.io";
          iframeLoaded = true;
        }
      }, 10);

      applyMarginShift(mainContent);
      applyMarginShift(footer);

      sessionStorage.setItem("aiPanelOpen", "true");
    }

    function closePanel() {
      sidePanel.classList.remove("open");
      sessionStorage.setItem("aiPanelOpen", "false");

      // Also reset any expanded/modal state when the panel is fully closed
      if (isExpanded) {
        isExpanded = false;
        sidePanel.classList.remove("expanded");
        panelBackdrop.classList.remove("visible");
        expandPanelBtn.innerHTML = EXPAND_ICON;
        expandPanelBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Expand panel");
        expandPanelBtn.title = "Expand";
      }

      const mainContent = getMainContentElement();
      removeMarginShift(mainContent);
      removeMarginShift(footer);
    }

    function expandPanel() {
      if (!sidePanel.classList.contains("open")) return;
      isExpanded = true;
      sidePanel.classList.add("expanded");
      panelBackdrop.classList.add("visible");
      expandPanelBtn.innerHTML = COLLAPSE_ICON;
      expandPanelBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Collapse panel");
      expandPanelBtn.title = "Collapse";

      // While expanded/centered, the panel no longer pushes page content
      const mainContent = getMainContentElement();
      removeMarginShift(mainContent);
      removeMarginShift(footer);
    }

    function collapsePanel() {
      isExpanded = false;
      sidePanel.classList.remove("expanded");
      panelBackdrop.classList.remove("visible");
      expandPanelBtn.innerHTML = EXPAND_ICON;
      expandPanelBtn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Expand panel");
      expandPanelBtn.title = "Expand";

      if (sidePanel.classList.contains("open")) {
        const mainContent = getMainContentElement();
        applyMarginShift(mainContent);
        applyMarginShift(footer);
        updatePanelPosition();
      }
    }

    expandPanelBtn.innerHTML = EXPAND_ICON;

    expandPanelBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (isExpanded) {
        collapsePanel();
      } else {
        expandPanel();
      }
    });

    // Clicking outside the centered modal reverts it back to the side panel
    panelBackdrop.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (isExpanded) {
        collapsePanel();
      }
    });

    askAiButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (sidePanel.classList.contains("open")) {
        closePanel();
      } else {
        openPanel();
      }
    });

    closePanelBtn.addEventListener("click", closePanel);

    window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
      if (
        sidePanel.classList.contains("open") &&
        isDesktopView() &&
        !isExpanded
      ) {
        updatePanelPosition();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      const mainContent = getMainContentElement();

      if (!isDesktopView()) {
        removeMarginShift(mainContent);
        removeMarginShift(footer);
        if (isExpanded) {
          collapsePanel();
        }
      } else {
        if (sessionStorage.getItem("aiPanelOpen") === "true") {
          if (!isExpanded) {
            updatePanelPosition();
            applyMarginShift(mainContent);
            applyMarginShift(footer);
          }
        }
      }
    });

    if (sessionStorage.getItem("aiPanelOpen") === "true" && isDesktopView()) {
      openPanel();
    }

    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", () => {
      const isOpen = sidePanel.classList.contains("open");
      sessionStorage.setItem("aiPanelOpen", isOpen ? "true" : "false");
    });
  });
</script>

function handleClick(event) {

    const button = event.currentTarget;
    const parentContainer = getParentContainer(button);

    if (!parentContainer) return;

    const parentId = parentContainer.id;
    const modal = findModal(parentId);

    if (!modal) return;

    const formDiv = modal.querySelector("[data-form-id]");

    if (!formDiv) return;

    const formId = formDiv.getAttribute("data-form-id");
	
	//console.log(formId);

    // Discovery meeting forms
    if (DISCOVERY_FORMS.includes(formId)) {

        addIframeToDiv(modal, parentId, formId);
        openModal(modal);
        return;
    }

    // Load the form only once
    if (!preloadedForms[parentId]) {

        const targetSelector =
            `.target-common-hubspot-class [class="${parentId}"] [data-form-id="${formId}"] div`;

        loadHubSpotForm(
            formId,
            targetSelector,
            parentContainer.classList.contains("OnSubmit-PlayVideo")
        );

        preloadedForms[parentId] = true;
    }

    openModal(modal);
}
	
	function findModal(parentId) {

		return Array.from(
			document.querySelectorAll(".target-common-hubspot-class")
		).find(modal =>
			modal.querySelector(`[class="${parentId}"]`)
		);
	}

	function openModal(modal) {
		modal.style.display = "block";
	}

	function waitForIframeAndUpdateId() {

		if (iframeUpdated) return;

		const interval = 50;
		const maxAttempts = 15;
		let attempts = 0;

		const intervalId = setInterval(() => {

			const iframe = document.querySelector("#hs-form-iframe-0");

			attempts++;

			if (iframe) {

				iframe.id = "hs-form-iframe-20";
				iframeUpdated = true;

				clearInterval(intervalId);
				return;
			}

			if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
				clearInterval(intervalId);
			}

		}, interval);
	}

	function loadHubSpotForm(formId, targetSelector, hasPlayVideoClass) {

		if (window.hbspt?.forms) {

			hbspt.forms.create({
				region: "na1",
				portalId: "3854161",
				formId: formId,
				target: targetSelector,

				...(hasPlayVideoClass && {
					onFormSubmitted: function () {
						window.open(
							"https://vimeo.com/938341264",
							"_blank"
						);
					}
				})
			});

			waitForIframeAndUpdateId();

		} else {

			window.hsFormsOnReady = window.hsFormsOnReady || [];

			window.hsFormsOnReady.push(() => {

				hbspt.forms.create({
					region: "na1",
					portalId: "3854161",
					formId: formId,
					target: targetSelector,

					...(hasPlayVideoClass && {
						onFormSubmitted: function () {
							window.open(
								"https://vimeo.com/938341264",
								"_blank"
							);
						}
					})
				});

				waitForIframeAndUpdateId();

			});

		}
	}
	
	function addIframeToDiv(modal, parentId, formId) {

		let iframeId;

		switch (formId) {

			case "discovery-call-h2r":
				iframeId = "iframe-discovery-call-h2r";
				break;

			case "discovery-call-h2r-tablet":
				iframeId = "iframe-discovery-call-h2r-tablet";
				break;

			default:
				iframeId = "iframe-discovery-call-h2r-small-" + parentId;
		}

		if (document.getElementById(iframeId)) return;

		const targetSelector =
			`.target-common-hubspot-class [class="${parentId}"] [data-form-id="${formId}"] div`;

		const targetElement = document.querySelector(targetSelector);

		if (!targetElement) {
			console.error("Target element not found.");
			return;
		}

		const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");

		//console.log(iframeId);
		
		iframe.id = iframeId;

		iframe.src =
			formId === "discovery-call-h2r-french"
				? "https://meetings.hubspot.com/bramh-gupta/discovery-call-robomq-hire2retire-french?embed=true"
				: "https://meetings.hubspot.com/bramh-gupta/discovery-call-robomq-hire2retire?embed=true";

		iframe.width = "100%";
		iframe.height = "750vh";
		iframe.frameBorder = "0";

		Object.assign(iframe.style, {
			border: "none",
			position: "absolute",
			top: "0",
			left: "0"
		});

		if (modal) {
			modal.style.position = "relative";
		}

		targetElement.appendChild(iframe);
	}
